scope.source_scope_rule: This register records observed run behavior and deferred repair work. It does not modify source, gates, ledgers, run outputs, or prior evidence.

state_snapshot.snapshot_authority_note: paid_calls/actual_cny/reserved_cny/uncertain_cny are historical EXECUTION_STATE snapshot values; current expense and paid-call decisions must use the current budget.sqlite SQL.
state_snapshot.quality_boundary: Program progress, native JSON, or a passing adapter test does not certify scientific quality or unattended robustness.

classification.formal_repair_produced_and_used: A source change is present in the current source-bound lineage and its use is evidenced by a bound run or native consumer receipt. Offline acceptance remains separately stated.
classification.manual_recovery_or_supervision: A root/delegated stop, hold, rejection, or restoration allowed the run to continue; this is not an autonomous program check.
classification.offline_only: A read-only or synthetic probe reproduced or checked the behavior without a paid provider call or production mutation.
classification.still_unfixed: The run has a guard or workaround, but the general unattended capability requested in the entry is absent.

issues.title: Directed reading focus, section, and chapter ownership were lost in generic fallback
issues.trigger: A directed read or supplement supplied a non-empty focus/section and assigned_chapters, but the adapter normalized it through the generic requirement path before the reader consumed those fields.
issues.actual_impact: Ten autonomous specific requests became generic readings without chapter ownership. Stable paper identities and source text remained intact, but evidence could be delivered to the wrong review purpose or chapter.
issues.temporary_handling: The V19 unpaid gate was stopped before new paid work. Old raw results and caches were retained, and the repair was resumed in a new source-bound namespace without hand-editing scientific content.
issues.formal_capability_status: Commit c6a5f01e added chapter aliases, focus-to-question normalization, section notes, and task signatures. The current V24 source be0abeaf is descended from that change; the saved harmonized projection passed 10/10 ownership checks. The projection check was offline and did not itself make provider calls.
issues.current_boundary: The repair preserves routing fields; it does not decide whether a model's scientific claim is correct.

lines 3538-3574 and 3679-3768; assigned_chapters, focus, section, and task signature are consumed

issues.repair_proposal: Keep the normalized routing fields in the immutable request/response contract and fail closed when chapter ownership is missing for a task that declares it. Retain the original task plus the normalized task as separate provenance.
issues.verification: Run a bound fixture with focus, section, assigned_chapters, explicit question, and generic reading together; assert exact reader message fields, chapter ownership, distinct task signatures, and zero provider calls for the adapter regression.

issues.title: Ambiguous transport attempts remain held without unattended cost reconciliation
issues.trigger: RemoteDisconnected, stream incomplete/error-event, and stream read-timeout events occurred after provider invocation but without a usable response or definitive provider charge status.
issues.actual_impact: The current run record retains eight unknown reservations totaling CNY 4.5168676; they still count toward the 80 CNY project cap. Remaining cap can be used for other authorized work. The historical A/B manifest separately retained six unknowns totaling CNY 0.3121156, including a batch-relevant RemoteDisconnected amount of CNY 0.0854376; the historical latest transport record held CNY 2.102376. These records must not be added blindly. Unknown work cannot be safely retried or declared successful.
issues.temporary_handling: The bounded SSE/raw-preservation path saved raw call identifiers and partial streams, held the eight unknown reservations, and prohibited automatic retry or re-buy of those ambiguous work items. It did not impose a universal stop on unrelated authorized reservations while cap remains; raw, paid, and rejected facts stayed separate.
issues.formal_capability_status: Transport safety is formal and was used, but end-to-end reconciliation is still absent. Provider status or idempotency may be used only when the official provider contract exposes and supports it; no such endpoint or capability is assumed here.
issues.current_boundary: Unknown holds consume the cap and keep completion certainty unresolved, while unrelated authorized work may continue within the remaining cap. The hold is a supervision boundary, not an autonomous settlement or refund.

Add an explicit unknown-to-settled/refunded ledger transition only when provider evidence exists, and keep unrelated authorized reservations independent.

issues.title: One A/B output root is not safe for independent concurrent writers
issues.trigger: Two independent child processes were released against the same batch_root and shared state/aggregate/pool paths.
issues.actual_impact: The offline probe reproduced PermissionError [WinError 5] while both processes replaced BATCH_STATE.json. The same design permits last-writer-wins state/aggregate loss, duplicate attempt allocation, and pool/bridge overwrite.
issues.temporary_handling: The probe used synthetic local data, made zero paid transport calls, touched no ledger, and did not touch the live batch. Current operation is constrained to one owner per root and separate roots for independent experiments.
issues.formal_capability_status: No cross-process owner lock or per-workkey lease is implemented. This is an offline reproduction, not a claim that the current live batch failed concurrently.
issues.current_boundary: SQLite budget serialization protects the cap but does not claim output ownership or deduplicate work.
